title: Step 2 output: idea brief + 3 localization angles
description: Produced from the source transcript by step 2. MUST NOT contain quotes, jokes, metaphors or the title of the source. Content language = project language. Stored in table brief (brief) and angle (each angle).

core_question.description: The ONE question the video answers (one sub-question if the source is > 15 min).

structure_idea.description: General arc only, e.g. dwelling -> fuel -> disaster -> today.

category.description: H history, W how it works, E economics, G geography/nature, S science, F food, Sp sport, P psychology, M motivation/discipline.

sensitive_topics.description: If non-empty: >= 2 independent sources per number + neutral-tone check.

operator_summary.description: Short summary in the UI language (ru) for the operator.

title.description: Working title in the content language.

hook_words.description: Local hook words, e.g. жұт, қыстау.
